fields.name: margin_available
fields.description: Whether the asset can be used as margin in multi-assets mode.

fields.name: total_initial_margin
fields.description: Total initial margin requirement. USDT only in single-asset mode; the sum of USD value of all cross positions/open order initial margin in multi-assets mode.

fields.name: total_maint_margin
fields.description: Total maintenance margin requirement. USDT only in single-asset mode; the sum of USD value of all cross positions maintenance margin in multi-assets mode.

fields.name: total_wallet_balance
fields.description: Total wallet balance. USDT only in single-asset mode; USD-denominated in multi-assets mode.

fields.name: total_unrealized_profit
fields.description: Total unrealized profit. USDT only in single-asset mode; USD-denominated in multi-assets mode.

fields.name: total_margin_balance
fields.description: Total margin balance. USDT only in single-asset mode; USD-denominated in multi-assets mode.

fields.name: total_position_initial_margin
fields.description: Initial margin required for positions. USDT only in single-asset mode; the sum of USD value of all cross positions initial margin in multi-assets mode.

fields.name: total_open_order_initial_margin
fields.description: Initial margin required for open orders. USDT only in single-asset mode; USD-denominated in multi-assets mode.

fields.name: total_cross_wallet_balance
fields.description: Cross wallet balance. USDT only in single-asset mode; USD-denominated in multi-assets mode.

fields.name: total_cross_un_pnl
fields.description: Unrealized PnL for cross positions. USDT only in single-asset mode; USD-denominated in multi-assets mode.

fields.name: available_balance
fields.description: Available balance. USDT only in single-asset mode; USD-denominated in multi-assets mode.

fields.name: max_withdraw_amount
fields.description: Maximum transferable/withdrawable amount. USDT only in single-asset mode; a maximum virtual USD amount in multi-assets mode.

fields.name: open_order_initial_margin
fields.description: Initial margin required for open orders.

fields.name: position_amt
fields.description: position amount, positive for long, negative for short

fields.name: initial_margin
fields.description: initial margin required with current mark price

fields.name: position_initial_margin
fields.description: initial margin required for positions with current mark price

fields.name: open_order_initial_margin
fields.description: initial margin required for open orders with current mark price

fields.name: complete_time
fields.description: represents deposit completion datetime, available for deposits after 6-Mar-2025.

fields.name: travel_rule_status
fields.description: 0: travel rule not required OR info already provided and funds ready to use, 1: travel rule required to provide deposit info

fields.name: transfer_type
fields.description: 1 for internal transfer, 0 for external transfer

fields.name: withdraw_order_id
fields.description: will not be returned if there's no withdrawOrderId for this withdraw.

fields.name: complete_time
fields.description: complete UTC time when user's asset is deduct from withdrawing, only if status =  6(success)

fields.name: asset_balances
fields.description: Per-asset balance detail for this wallet. Only present when `needBalanceDetail=true` is passed; omitted entirely otherwise.

fields.name: actual_instance
fields.type: Optional[Union[AccountConfigUpdate, AccountUpdate, AlgoUpdate, ConditionalOrderTriggerReject, GridUpdate, ListenKeyExpired, MarginCall, OrderTradeUpdate, StrategyUpdate, TradeLite]]

fields.name: bc
fields.description: Balance Change except PnL and Commission

fields.name: sp
fields.description: Stop Price. Please ignore with TRAILING_STOP_MARKET order

fields.name: M
fields.description: modifyId, only pushed for AMENDMENT (order modification) events when a modifyId was provided in the request

fields.name: m
fields.description: Is this trade the maker side?

fields.name: cp
fields.description: If Close-All, pushed with conditional order

fields.name: AP
fields.description: Activation Price, only pushed with TRAILING_STOP_MARKET order

fields.name: cr
fields.description: Callback Rate, only pushed with TRAILING_STOP_MARKET order

fields.name: pP
fields.description: If price protection is turned on

fields.name: gtd
fields.description: TIF GTD order auto cancel time
